body: Quick pass: merges cleanly with main; body complete; no snapshot PNG touched; all 41 operation icons drawn original (nothing from SolidCraft, see the decision file). The quick gate fell back to batch because `Cargo.lock` changed; the author ran the touched crates' suites (all `camcraft-ui`, `cargo test -p xtask`, clippy on both, `cargo xtask icons --check`) green on 733ea76c. Flagged ready for review. It adds `resvg` as an `xtask`-only dependency and changes `xtask/`, so the verdict will be the maintainer's to confirm.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 733ea76c719a86e60c2fd9983fe9b1c7d2d8dcf4 -->
**Reviewed and built; the new dependency is the maintainer's decision.** No blockers found. Ready for the maintainer to merge once the `resvg` dev-tool dependency is accepted.

**What looks good**
- 13 of the 41 SVG masters read in full (2D Chamfer, Face, Thread Milling, Pocket, 5-axis Contour, Advanced Swarf, Deburr, Engrave, Groove Finish, Plasma Profile, Probe, Taper Turning, Rotary Offset). All use `viewBox="0 0 24 24"` and only `path`, `rect`, `circle` and `g` (transform). No `image`, `href`, `url(`, `style`, `text`, `script`, editor metadata or credit comment. A grep of all 41 for solidcraft, hsmworks, fusion and autodesk finds nothing.
- No file under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` changed. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 16 -> 17 (main is at 16). Body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #661` with no closing keyword.
- The PNGs are binary (`-text`). No `build.rs`, no workflow or script change. `resvg` appears only in `xtask`.
- The structural test walks `KindInfo::ALL` (the app's full kind table, `KIND_COUNT`). `op_icon` is an exhaustive match. Each kind maps to its own `op-*` master, and no two share one.
- The 18 deleted PNG stems have no remaining `assets/ui/<stem>.png` or `"<stem>.png"` reference. The remaining grep hits are unrelated (serde names, comments, log strings).
- Mutation check: I changed `op-face.svg` (`M3 16.5H21` to `M3 16H21`). `committed_icon_pngs_match_their_svg_masters` failed with "op-face.png: differs from its master by 192". I restored the file, and the tree is clean.
- The trial merge with current origin/main was clean.

**Local results (trial merge with current origin/main; worktree default target/)**

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 38 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask icons --check` | 0 breaches |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from crates/ui) | 537 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the `#[ignore]`d snapshot tests (per the rule), the batch gate, and the app itself.

**Dependency facts for the maintainer**
- `cargo tree -i resvg --workspace` shows only `xtask`. It is not in camcraft-ui, camcraft-app or any shipped crate, and the release-build test confirms xtask is never built in release.
- `resvg` 0.45.1 is pinned (`=0.45.1`, default features off) and is Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
- Transitive crates: tiny-skia 0.11.4 is BSD-3-Clause. usvg 0.45.1, svgtypes 0.15.3, kurbo 0.11.3, roxmltree 0.20.0, png 0.17.16, base64 0.22.1, data-url 0.3.2, imagesize 0.13.0, rgb 0.8.53, simplecss 0.2.2, float-cmp 0.9.0, pico-args 0.5.0 and xmlwriter 0.1.0 are MIT, Apache-2.0 or dual. Nothing copyleft (GPL, LGPL, MPL). BSD-3 and MIT ask for their notice in source distributions. This is a dev tool that is not shipped, so no notice is owed in the app.
- `Cargo.lock` has additions only (no removed lines). No existing version moved.

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Provenance beyond the checks above rests on the author's statement. The decision file (`docs/decisions/661-icon-set.md`) says the worker read SolidCraft's style guide and one SolidCraft SVG (`chamfer`) before the licence change. It then redrew the whole set on the 24-unit grid and recomposed 2D Chamfer. I did not compare against SolidCraft's files, and I did not fetch them. Whether that disclosure is enough under SolidCraft's brand licence is for the maintainer to decide. It is an upstream-licence question rather than a clean-room one.
2. Determinism: the PNG check allows 8 per channel, so a different CPU's anti-aliasing should not cause a false failure. The xtask unit test runs in the quick and batch gates for everyone whenever `xtask/` changes.
3. Looks (sheet rendered at 16 px, zoom 4; the sheet has no labels, so I identified icons by position): the families read well (turning, multi-axis, rotary, 2D). Face vs Facing and the Groove and Profile rough/finish pairs look close at 16 px. Thread Milling is thin. None of them looks identical to another, so these are notes, not blockers.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Back to draft: merging main (PR #1117 took PROCESS_VERSION 17) and bumping this PR to PROCESS_VERSION 18.
Maintainer (question dialog, 2026-11-12): "Yes, merge" - `resvg` is accepted as an xtask-only developer dependency. The branch takes main and the next free process version first.
Back to draft: merging main (about 55 merges) and taking PROCESS_VERSION 24.

Checked by the main session after the reviewed head b908a6a0: one merge of main on top (the icon-table structural test moved unchanged into `tests/op_icon_table.rs` because main's new ribbon test filled `structural.rs`; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 24); own diff against main is the same content, no snapshot PNG; author's runs on 8844d60e: xtask 48, `icons --check` clean, ui lib 569, clippy clean. Maintainer said "Yes, merge" (dependency accepted). Merging.
